WHAT IS TRIPLE TWIST?

Triple Twist is a draw game where the goal is to match your numbers with the winning numbers selected in the drawing. There are ten different ways to win!

Ticket Price: $2

Drawings: Mondays through Sundays


HOW TO PURCHASE TICKETS AND PLAY

How to Purchase a Ticket

Find an Arizona Lottery retailer. Triple Twist tickets cost $2 per game and are available for purchase at the counter of Arizona Lottery Retailers and at Arizona Lottery vending machines. Tickets cannot be purchased online.

How to Choose Your Numbers

There are two ways to choose your numbers.

Choose six numbers from 1 to 42 on the first row of your ticket, or let the computer pick them for you. The computer will then choose the remaining two rows of six numbers for you.

How to Win

Match three or more of your numbers in a single row, either your pick or quick picked, to the winning drawn numbers. Match all six numbers in a single row to win the jackpot.

You can win up to four times on a single game by matching your numbers to the winning numbers in each corresponding row or combination of rows.

How to Play Your Numbers in more than one Drawing

You can play your numbers for as many as 12 consecutive drawing dates on the same ticket. Just tell the cashier at the time of your purchase or mark the Number of Draws box on your selection slip.

How to Check the Winning Numbers

You can find the winning numbers online, or you can check your tickets by using a ticket scanner at an Arizona Lottery retailer or by calling the Winning Numbers Hotline:

Phoenix: 480.829.7425
Tucson: 520.325.9141
All Other Areas: 800.499.3798

ABOUT WINNING

How to Claim Your Winnings

All Arizona Lottery retailers will redeem prizes up to $100, and may redeem prizes up to $599. See full details about How to Claim Prizes.

 

TRIPLE TWIST FAQS

What are the odds of winning Triple Twist?

The overall odds of winning a cash prize are approximately 1 in 7.9.

When are Triple Twist drawings held?

Drawings are held Monday through Sunday.

How often can I play my numbers?

You can play your numbers for up to 12 consecutive drawing dates on the same ticket. Just tell the cashier at the time of your purchase or mark the Number of Draws box on your selection slip.

How long do I have to claim a Triple Twist prize?

You have 180 days from the date of the drawing to claim a prize. Once a ticket has expired, it cannot be redeemed even if it is a winner.

What happens if multiple people win the jackpot?

The players will share the jackpot in equal amounts.

 

*Sales stop on draw nights at 6:59 p.m. Arizona time from the second Sunday in March through the first Saturday in November and at 7:59 pm Arizona time from the first Sunday in November through the second Saturday in March.

**Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

***Drawing prizes must be claimed within 180 days of the drawing.

All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.
